_deck_note: ONE DECK PER SEAT. Four personas are one model wearing four hats, so 4/4 agreement on a single shared input can be one blind spot rather than four readers (.claude/agents/README.md, 'The honest ceiling of this technique'). Suggested assignment: abzan-defenders -> mtg-deck-tuner (a real build-around with a concrete tuning job), acererak-combo -> mtg-skeptic (combo claims are the most checkable thing we assert), judith-tokens-connoiseur -> mtg-phone-player (token-dense, so the graph is at its worst on 390px), mono-blue-blink -> mtg-precon-player (least jargon burden, so a vocabulary failure here is the tool's and not the deck's).
_goal_note: Every goal below is phrased the way a PLAYER would say it, never in this tool's vocabulary. A goal written as 'inspect the breadth axis' tests nothing, because it hands the persona the word we are trying to find out whether they know. That is the whole knowledge-ceiling axis, and it is the only axis that has ever produced a persona-specific finding here.
